partnership_announcements.description: Peekabox has signed partnerships with 20 major F&B brands in the UAE, including Carrefour, Costa Coffee, Tim Hortons, Dunkin', Krispy Kreme, Paul, Eataly, Cinnabon, Pret a Manger, Armani Cafe and Union Coop, giving access to a combined network of over 1,000 store locations, 200 of which are already live on the app.

press_references.value: UAE start-up sells surplus food at discount prices to cut waste and ease cost of living

product_launches.description: Peekabox launched its surplus-food marketplace app in the UAE, enabling consumers to buy end-of-day surplus items from more than 1,000 partner outlets at steep discounts.

overview_description.description:
Peekabox is a food-tech that sells fresh surplus food from cafes, restaurants and grocery stores at substantial discounts. 

Partnered with 1,000+ stores including Carrefour, Costa, Tim Hortons, Union-Coop, Paul, and many more. 

Raised $1.5M pre-seed.
